prompts:
Use case: ui-mockup / precise-object-edit.
Asset type: polished medieval fantasy PC game dialogue UI concept composited over a real gameplay screenshot.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: actual Witch's Lodge game running at 1774x887. Return ONE full landscape gameplay screenshot, same 2:1 aspect ratio, ideally 1774x887 or 1792x896. This is a UI layout study, not new game environment art.
INVARIANTS: preserve the snowy isometric lodge environment, camera, all top HUD, bottom storage/lodge buttons, bottom workbench props, and their positions exactly. Preserve the existing fairy character illustration, identity, face, costume, antler-like thistle staff and wings; reuse/reposition/scale/crop the same illustration, do not redraw as another character. Keep the same subdued gameplay backdrop. Replace/remove the ENTIRE existing central wavy black dialogue panel and its contents, then build ONLY the new dialogue UI described below. No ghost copies of old text or old portrait. No extra HUD, no extra characters, no invented game scene. Layout must feel polished and production ready, calm, organized and readable at actual screen size. Medieval fantasy materials, deep plum, muted brass, warm ivory, restrained green; clean flat text surface, few delicate decorations. Avoid modern mobile-app cards, neon, huge scroll curls, excessive ornate borders, paper texture behind letters.
Required exact Korean copy, with readable consistent typography and hierarchy:
small story label "창이 떨린 밤"
speaker name "티슬"
small metadata "요정 · 전투용병"
dialogue in 3 lines: "지난밤 창이 떨렸습니다." / "엉겅퀴 창은 거짓을 모릅니다." / "어둠이 가까이 왔습니다."
two choice buttons: "1  밤엔 문 안에 있어 줘." and "2  작은 몸으로 괜찮겠어?"
small unobtrusive "Esc 닫기". Name should be medium-large, dialogue comfortable about 22px in 1774-wide screenshot, metadata smaller; generous gutters, exact aligned starts. Do not add explanatory annotations or concept titles on the image.
CONCEPT A — INTEGRATED DIALOGUE PANEL. Refine the current horizontal center composition into a compact, disciplined single frame. Main frame approximately x360..1415, y325..655. Straight stable edges with softly clipped medieval corners and a very thin muted-brass line. Quiet deep-plum matte panel, subtle edge shadow. Left portrait compartment x380..650, cropped at waist and cleanly contained by the lower panel boundary, head can project modestly above frame. Middle dialogue column x685..1045: story label then speaker name and metadata in one compact header, slim divider, 3-line body. Right choice column x1090..1385: tiny "마녀의 대답", two evenly sized 56px high restrained ivory button rows, not huge parchment slabs. First choice a subtle green/brass selected state, second neutral same legibility. Equal 20px padding and a single clear vertical separator. Position small close affordance at top right. Reduce empty vertical space, align the first choice with first dialogue line. Preserve environment outside this new frame. Overall calm dark jewel tone with clear hierarchy and abundant room for the game.
